result:
Iteration 8 adds a reference-style floating card preview:

- Hovering a rail card now opens a larger preview above the rail instead of clipping inside the card.
- The floating preview keeps Play, My List, rating, and expand actions fully wired.
- It shows title artwork, metadata, genres, and Continue Watching progress.
- Positioning adapts to viewport edges so previews remain visible.
- Verified production build and headless interaction: floating preview, action buttons, rating dialog, and error-free console.
- API checks and persistence behavior remain unchanged and passing.
